entries.current_equivalent: Existing host health check; standalone readiness is exercised through /api/saas/session.
GET /session in host mount; standalone demo session remains isolated.
Existing verified SSO/sign-in; no replacement password database.
POST /demo/session; server-held synthetic identities and strict Origin/CSRF.
Existing host sign-out/session revocation.
GET /workspace; independent module navigation and scoped records, plus activity/branch summaries.
POST /parties; CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER/BOTH/LENDER, shared contacts with branch checks.
POST /vehicles; owned/consigned stock and automatic private Passport relationship/history.
POST /intake/preview and /intake/import with VEHICLE; atomic reviewed rows, DRAFT status.
POST /vehicles/{id}/readiness; optimistic version, documents and inspection.
POST /vehicles/{id}/price; existing stock repricing.
POST /vehicles/{id}/publish makes stock available; explicit /marketplace/requests publishes it.
POST /vehicles/{id}/reserve; reconciliation withdraws unavailable public inventory.
POST /vehicles/{id}/release; available stock can be explicitly republished.
Automatic private lifecycle history; /passports/link, /passports/{vin}, /contributions for reviewed notes.
Automatic private lifecycle history; /passports/link, /passports/{vin}, /contributions for reviewed notes.
Local public /public-marketplace feed and /marketplace listing permalink; signed receiver for main-site delivery.
Dealer /bills; parts /parts/{id}/receive; general /office-expenses. Currency/rates, input tax, AP and settlement FX are retained.
POST /parts; dedicated SKU stock separate from vehicle sales/fleet.
POST /parts-orders; reservation, tax/discount, buyer invoice, separate verified payment and fulfilment.
POST /parts-orders/{id}/fulfil; releases inventory and recognises net sales/COGS.
POST /parts-orders/{id}/return; full return restores cost, reverses tax/sale and records refund due; /refund confirms cash.
POST /invoices supports CASH/INSTALLMENT/PARTNER, lender/agreement, policy and instalment schedule; safe buyer document.
POST /invoices/{id}/handover; confirmed settlement or owner-approved eligible credit release; deferred income earned.
POST /invoices/{id}/return; quarantine/readiness reset, stock recovery, refund liability and owner-payout reconciliation guard.
POST /payments for dealer INVOICE/BILL/CONSIGNMENT/REFUND; /receipts for parts/services. Evidence stays unposted.
POST /payments/{id}/verify or /receipts/{id}/verify; independent confirmation, exact carrying/FX and buyer receipt.
POST /capital; also reviewed opening/adjustment journals through /financial/journals.
/financial/settings for fiscal/policy/closing/tax identity; /organisation/profile for business name/primary activity.
Existing /reports remains compatible; new /financial-reports adds presets, historical ageing, detailed UI, review and nine-file export.
Existing /ledger retained; scoped/date-based general ledger in /financial-reports and CSV export.
GET /fx with configured timestamped reference provider, cache/stale rejection and explicit manual-rate fallback workflow.
POST /estimate; exact landed costs/contingency/margin and unposted price estimate.
POST /leads, GET /tools; scoped customer interest/contact and follow-up.
POST /leads/{id}; versioned stage, notes and follow-up updates.
GET /integrations; separately trusted INTEGRATION_WORKER /platform/subscribers/{tenant}/outbox/{event}/ack, confirmed consumer reference.
GET /workspace and /tools; business, branch, membership, settings and purchased activity context.
POST /organisation/profile; primary must be a selected activity.
POST /branches and /branches/{id}; allowance, modules, scope and historical assignment preservation.
POST /staff/invitations; verified host subject, scoped roles/modules, reserved capacity, expiry and acceptance page.
POST /staff/invitations/{id}/accept from the named verified host account; account creation/sign-in remains host-owned.
POST /staff/{id}/disable; owner/self and privileged-role safeguards.
POST /staff/{id}/enable; active plan/capacity and role authority.
POST /staff/{id}/access; owner-constrained role/module/branch editor.
POST /staff/{id}/access with branches and module checks.
POST /vehicle-transfers, then dispatch/receive/cancel/resolve; source/destination checks and frozen historical branch journals.
POST /transfers; quantity/cost, reservations, destination confirmation and finance-reviewed shortages.
POST /fleet/assets and /status; separate rental/haulage fleet, VIN/capacity/conflict checks and Passport history.
Distinct POST /rentals, /haulage and /workshop; industry-specific schedules, agreements, inspection, POD and job details.
Rental checkout/return/cancel; haulage assign/dispatch/deliver/cancel; workshop start/complete/cancel, with scope/version guards.
POST /service-invoices; deferred/earned services, discount/tax, due terms, buyer documents and full credit/refund/void.
POST /receipts {invoice_id,amount,reference}; service/parts payment evidence.
POST /receipts/{id}/verify; independently confirmed posting and receipt document.
GET /passports/{vin}; authorised linked relationship, private local records and explicitly shared cross-business records only.
POST /passports/{vin}/contributions; append-only source/category/date/evidence, PRIVATE/SHARED and DECLARED/REVIEWED.
Owner-controlled existing business grants, plus named-account grants, expiry and revocation; source private evidence stays private.
POST /intake/preview; conservative text/CSV/transcript extraction including Passport events, no draft/source audit persistence, reviewed commit.
GET /entitlements; status, purchased modules, capacity and history availability.
GET/POST /platform/catalogue; versioned activity/core/marketplace rates, tier allowances and extra-unit prices.
GET/POST /platform/catalogue; versioned activity/core/marketplace rates, tier allowances and extra-unit prices.
GET /platform/subscribers; separately authorised paginated directory and per-subscriber usage.
Quote-pinned /platform/subscribers/{tenant}/activate after independently confirmed payment; no tenant-owner global powers.
GET /platform/audit for separately granted PLATFORM_AUDIT; platform subscriber decisions and catalogue history.
GET /branch-summary plus module dashboards and branch-filtered financial reports.
Parts /transfers and vehicle /vehicle-transfers; GET /workspace exposes scoped transfer records for each screen.
Parts /transfers and vehicle /vehicle-transfers; GET /workspace exposes scoped transfer records for each screen.
POST /transfers/{id}/dispatch (parts) or /vehicle-transfers/{id}/dispatch; value moved to transit.
Destination /receive confirms part quantity or vehicle VIN/evidence; discrepancies retain unresolved value.
Undispatched request cancellation only.
Finance-reviewed parts FOUND/LOSS or confirmed correct-vehicle receipt; no silent transit write-off.
GET /marketplace and POST /marketplace/requests; photos, preview, plan gate, direct-only mode, public URL, durable delivery and withdrawal.
GET /marketplace and POST /marketplace/requests; photos, preview, plan gate, direct-only mode, public URL, durable delivery and withdrawal.
GET /platform/subscribers/{tenant}/marketplace after authorised directory selection.
POST /platform/subscribers/{tenant}/marketplace/{id}/moderate; expected generation, reason and separate platform authority.
POST /office-expenses and GET /workspace; currency, booked rate, approved input tax, category, branch/activity and supplier balance.
POST /office-expenses and GET /workspace; currency, booked rate, approved input tax, category, branch/activity and supplier balance.
POST /expense-categories, GET /tools categories and recurring expense category selector.
POST /expense-categories, GET /tools categories and recurring expense category selector.
POST /expense-templates, GET /tools; due frequency/category/amount and disable.
POST /expense-templates, GET /tools; due frequency/category/amount and disable.
POST /expense-templates/{id}/generate; one due draft advances once and never auto-charges cash.
POST /office-expenses/{id}/approve; finance scope and optimistic version.
POST /office-expenses/{id}/reject; no posted accounting on rejected draft.
POST /office-expenses/{id}/post; approved expense net/input-tax/AP posting, followed by independently confirmed settlement and FX.
